# Performance

<!-- Generated by `python3 tests/hands-on/bench.py report` from docs/performance/results/. Don't edit this file: record a new run with bench.py, or change the text in tests/hands-on/tools/perf_report.py, then regenerate. -->

How long common commands take in each released version of the CLI. Times are the median end-to-end time, in
milliseconds, against a local Umbraco site with a small set of test content, so they include Umbraco's own
time. Lower is better. Compare rows within one table: each table is one Umbraco version on one machine.

## Umbraco 17.7.0

| CLI | Startup | Read one item | List data types | Export content | Diff schema |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 0.1.0-alpha.6 | 93 | 298 | - | 391 | - |
| 0.1.0-alpha.15 | 109 | 313 | 312 | 414 | 456 |
| 0.1.0-rc.2 | 110 | 281 | 272 | 298 | 348 |

`-` means that version couldn't run the command, usually because it doesn't have it yet.

Measured 2026-09-30 on AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 logical cores), Windows 11 (10.0.26200). Each
time is the median of 10 runs.

## What each column runs

| Column | Command |
|---|---|
| Startup | `umbraco --version` |
| Read one item | `umbraco content get <home>` |
| List data types | `umbraco data-type list --all` |
| Export content | `umbraco content export --out <file>` |
| Diff schema | `umbraco schema diff tests/hands-on/fixtures/schema.json` |

How these numbers are measured, how to read them, and how to add a run: [Performance
testing](performance-testing.md).
